hooks.text: 三色宝石在限时窗口触发技能，出牌顺序决定连击爆发
hooks.excerpt: Creating a deck that unleashes maximum damage and triggers high-speed combos within a limited time window is the key to victory. ANTHEM#9 delivers strategic depth and a kinetic rush as a Gem-Match roguelite experience that’s both cerebral and thrilling.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 技能所需宝石颜色可自行改写，随机地牢中不断校准牌组
hooks.excerpt: In randomly generated dungeons, collect Attack Skills and "Blessings", and build your deck that tips the scale of battle in your favor.. Customize which colored gems your skills require, fine-tune your strategy, and take down formidable foes as you climb deeper into the dungeon.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三名特工分别改色、拆双宝石或吞宝石叠盾，AP规则完全不同
hooks.excerpt: Rubit’s specialty lies in adaptability—by spending AP, she can change the color of her gems on the fly. Even when the board isn’t in her favor, she can recover from tight situations and keep the combos flowing. Phannie A hedonistic gambler. Uses a gun for his flashy and bold fighting style. He can spend AP to split double gems. Increasing his total gems synergizes perfectly with skills that trigger multiple times! With a high-risk high-reward approach, he can unleash massive combos that no other character could! Beni A martial artist who fights for the pride of her people. She's a self-proclaimed hero! She can use AP to consume gems in exchange for Shield, healing, Attack buffs, and more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
